daf7f066b0.q: What personal liability risks do executors face when distributing estate assets?
daf7f066b0.a: If you settle an estate and distribute the residue before everything is settled, before all debts are cleared, or before receiving a clearance certificate from the CRA confirming taxes are handled properly, the executor can end up being held personally responsible and have to return those assets. This can be a heavy responsibility.

a8cfc68be8.q: What is the CRA clearance certificate and why is it important for executors?
a8cfc68be8.a: A clearance certificate from the CRA confirms that taxes due on the estate have been handled properly. Executors must ensure they have this certificate before distributing the residue of the estate; otherwise, they can face personal liability if tax issues arise later.
